items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: do you and Cynthia try to keep track of things like what happened with that Paul Simon date

ctx.x: You remember some things but I swear to God like some commercials, you know jingles, you go in for one hour and you don’t even remember what it was, and you get residual checks for years. You know thousands of dollars perhaps. And you don’t even remember what the product was. It’s funny.

And is the reverse of that true? Have you ever — do you and Cynthia try to keep track of things like what happened with that Paul Simon date, did I ever get paid for that? Or don’t you have to do that?

Well you know you keep track of when you — you’re sure when you don’t get paid. You keep track of that. But like you know when you’re doing a lot of jingles, every 13 weeks is a payment if they keep running it. So ads would add up. And the great thing about it was the pension contributions of 10% on residuals as well as the actual date. So that’s a great feature, you know, thanks to the union.
